description: Na₂Mo(H₂O₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.64 Å. Mo is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.05 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.62 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Mo and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, one Mo, and one H atom.
